research.name: Cottages
research.description: Unlocks the Cottage: Workers move in.

research.name: Manors
research.description: Unlocks the Manor: Burghers move in.

research.name: Advanced Provisioner
research.description: Unlocks the Advanced Provisioner (fish + potato → provisions).

missions.name: Found Your Realm
missions.tip: Found a Town on open ground beside a forest. Huts bring Peasants; Peasants work the Lumberjacks.

missions.name: Trade Winds
missions.tip: Give your second Town potato fields. Specialised Towns trade with each other, and every trade pays the Crown a Tariff.

missions.name: The King's Scholars
missions.tip: Place the Research Center next to the Castle. Research is paid in Goods from the Castle Stock — royal Traders buy them from your Towns.

missions.name: A Growing Town
missions.tip: Research an upgrade (e.g. Sturdy Huts), then select a building in its Town panel and upgrade it.

missions.name: Trade Routes
missions.tip: Roads double Trader speed. More Towns trading means more Tariff.

missions.name: The Workers Arrive
missions.tip: Workers need Fish and Coal. Research the Fishery and a Charcoal Burner or Coal Mine first.

missions.name: The King's Works
missions.tip: Level up your Towns (Town panel) for more building slots and Traders.

missions.name: Burghers
missions.tip: Burghers need Lamps, Bread, Mead and Clothes — a web of Worker-tier chains across your Towns.

missions.name: The Good Life
missions.tip: Aristocrats need Lamps, Mead, Iron Armor, Chairs and Pottery, plus Brandy, Luxury Clothes and Gold Rings. Make them perfectly happy to win.
